reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount, but recomputes the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules that the matching code uses.

duplication.why: Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold, so the tolerance definition now lives in two places.

placement.why: The worst-case rule is added in the shared amount helper in shared/schedules where the ranged rule already lives.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and its callers, with only incidental reformatting.

maintainability.why: A loose op?: string third parameter behind a positional boolean (always passed as false) must be threaded by every caller, so callers that forget it silently get the old rule; desktop-client callers (Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile list) were not updated.

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is copied literally, not disguised

one_place.where: Rule sits in getScheduledAmount but only applies when callers pass op; server/preview callers pass it, while desktop-client callers (accounts/Balance.tsx scheduled balance, SchedulesTable, mobile schedules) still call getScheduledAmount(amount) and keep the exact value
